# Pita Cigars

> Pita Cigars (Flor de Pita) is a family-owned cigar maker founded in 1968 by Arnaldo Laurencio, based in Miami, Florida. Every cigar is hand-rolled in Estelí, Nicaragua from aged Nicaraguan long-filler tobacco. Products are sold through brick-and-mortar retailers, not online. Tobacco products are intended for adults 21 years of age or older.

Factory and office: 1830 NW 20th St, Miami, FL 33142 · Phone: (305) 548-1212 · Email: pitacigars@att.net · Hours: Mon-Fri 9AM-5PM

## Premium Naked Bundles

Long-filler puros, aged and hand-rolled in Esteli, Nicaragua.

- [Torpedo Habano](https://www.pitacigars.com/product/torpedo-habano/): Habano Shade Wrapper, Medium strength, bundle of 25 cigars, $40.00 plus tax. Tasting notes: Espresso, Dark Cocoa, Black Pepper, Cedar, Leather.
- [Torpedo Connecticut](https://www.pitacigars.com/product/torpedo-connecticut/): Connecticut Shade Wrapper, Mild – Medium strength, bundle of 25 cigars, $40.00 plus tax. Tasting notes: Cream, Cedar, Almond, Sweet Hay, White Pepper.
- [Robusto Sumatra](https://www.pitacigars.com/product/robusto-sumatra/): Sumatra Shade Wrapper, Mild – Medium strength, bundle of 25 cigars, $40.00 plus tax. Tasting notes: Sweet Spice, Cedar, Toasted Bread, Raisin, Coffee.
- [Robusto Indonesian](https://www.pitacigars.com/product/robusto-indonesian/): Indonesian Wrapper, Medium strength, bundle of 25 cigars, $40.00 plus tax. Tasting notes: Earth, Dark Cocoa, Oak, Molasses, Black Pepper.
- [Churchill Sumatra](https://www.pitacigars.com/product/churchill-sumatra/): Sumatra Shade Wrapper, Mild – Medium strength, bundle of 25 cigars, $40.00 plus tax. Tasting notes: Sweet Spice, Cedar, Toasted Nuts, Earth, Coffee.
- [Churchill Oscuro](https://www.pitacigars.com/product/churchill-indonesian/): Indonesian Wrapper, Medium strength, bundle of 25 cigars, $40.00 plus tax. Tasting notes: Earth, Dark Cocoa, Oak, Molasses, Black Pepper.
- [Toro aka 52 Regular](https://www.pitacigars.com/product/toro-habano/): Indonesian Wrapper, Medium strength, bundle of 25 cigars, $40.00 plus tax. Tasting notes: Earth, Dark Cocoa, Oak, Black Pepper, Baking Spice.

## Flor de Pita Bundles

Short-filler fumas, Cuban-seed tobacco hand-rolled in Nicaragua, 25 cigars per paper-wrapped bundle. Details: https://www.pitacigars.com/bundles/

- Babies: 4.75 x 32, $20.00 plus tax
- Small Fumas (Mediano): 6.25 x 44, $25.00 plus tax
- Super Cazadores: 7.375 x 46, $30.00 plus tax
- Gigantes Fumas: 8 x 46, $30.00 plus tax

## Flor de Pita Boxes

Long-filler cigars in 25-count boxes, aged and hand-rolled in Esteli, Nicaragua. Details: https://www.pitacigars.com/boxes/

- [Presidente Sumatra](https://www.pitacigars.com/product/box-presidente-sumatra/): Sumatra Shade Wrapper, Medium strength, box of 25 cigars, $100.00 plus tax. Tasting notes: Cedar, Cream, Sweet Spice, Almond, Coffee.
- [Presidente Indonesian](https://www.pitacigars.com/product/box-presidente-indonesian/): Indonesian Wrapper, Medium – Full strength, box of 25 cigars, $100.00 plus tax. Tasting notes: Earth, Dark Cocoa, Espresso, Molasses, Leather.
- [Robusto Sumatra](https://www.pitacigars.com/product/box-robusto-sumatra/): Sumatra Shade Wrapper, Medium strength, box of 25 cigars, $90.00 plus tax. Tasting notes: Sweet Spice, Cedar, Toasted Bread, Raisin, Coffee.
- [Robusto Indonesian](https://www.pitacigars.com/product/box-robusto-indonesian/): Indonesian Wrapper, Medium – Full strength, box of 25 cigars, $90.00 plus tax. Tasting notes: Earth, Dark Cocoa, Oak, Molasses, Black Pepper.
